## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The code change is small and correct. `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` is now 60, an explicit `--timeout` still overrides it, and the updated `test_defaults` checks the new value. One documentation defect remains: the README still says the default timeout is 30 seconds.

## Suggestions
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Changing `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60` makes `README.md:3` false, because it still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." while `parse_args([])` now returns `timeout == 60`. Could you change that README line to "60 seconds" in this PR? — Anyone who reads the README will expect requests to time out at 30 seconds when they actually wait up to 60, which can lead them to set the wrong timeouts or misread slow-upstream behavior.

## Strengths
- `tests/test_cli.py:8` checks the new default through `parse_args([])`, so the test would fail if the default went back to 30.
- `tests/test_cli.py:14-15` still checks that an explicit `--timeout 12` overrides the default, which confirms the override claim in the PR description.
